passive.name: Granite Shield
passive.description: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.

spells.name: Seismic Shard
spells.description: Malphite launches a shard of earth at an enemy, dealing magic damage and Slowing them by % for seconds. Malphite also steals the amount Slowed, gaining it as Move Speed for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation QDamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Thunderclap
spells.description: Passive: Malphite gains % Armor (%i:scaleArmor%). This effect is increased to % (%i:scaleArmor%) while Granite Shield is active. Active: Malphite's next Attack deals an additional physical damage and creates an aftershock which deals physical damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit in their direction. His Attacks continue to create aftershocks %i:OnHit% On-Hit for the next seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalBonusDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Ground Slam
spells.description: Malphite slams the ground, dealing magic damage and reducing Attack Speed by % for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation EDamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Unstoppable Force
spells.description: Malphite charges with the force of a landslide, dashing Unstoppably. At the end of the dash, Malphite Knocks Up for seconds and deals magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
